Complete your PDR by 31 July

  • Meet our latest Above & Beyond Award winners...

  • Outcomes of Senate and Council Elections

    Online elections have been held for a Professional Services Staff member on Council and two members of the Assembly on Senate. Successful candidates have now been announced and further details of the results are available for Council and Senate.

  • Rise for Warwick in QS World University Rankings

    Good news - we’ve risen six places to 68th in the QS World University Rankings, and Warwick is 10th in the UK. Now, we announce Warwick’s goal to be top 50 by 2030.

  • Estates satisfaction survey now open

    Your feedback helps to shape the spaces and services you use every day, from post, cleaning and maintenance to refurbishment projects. Share your experiences for the chance to win a £10 shopping voucher.

  • Confirmation and Clearing Hotline: We need you

    Volunteer to join our team handling around 5,000 calls from across the world - it’s a fast-paced, rewarding role with full training provided. Discover what’s involved and sign up by Friday 10 July.

What this day means to me: Reserves Day

We're proud to have colleagues who are reservists - giving up their spare time to serve in the Reserve Forces - balancing a civilian life with a military career, so that should their country require them, they would be ready to serve as part of the military. We took the chance to catch up with Claudiu Iordache from Warwick Global Academy who told us more about his experiences as a reservist.

Warm weather advice from the Registrar

Dear colleagues,
